description: A copy of ALM's Tangle Quartet: four voltage-controlled amplifiers with individual outputs and a mix that each channel drops out of when its own output is used

params.text: Sets that channel's level from silence to unity and comes up fully open; while that channel's Level CV jack is patched the knob stops setting the level and scales the jack's voltage instead

inputs.text: Sets that channel's level, 0V for silence and the top of the chosen voltage range for the knob's full setting; a cable sitting at 0V therefore silences the channel

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its level; putting a cable in here takes the channel out of the Mix
The sum of those channels whose own output jacks are empty

notes: a channel leaves the Mix the moment a cable goes into its own output jack. That is how one module is split between a mix and separate destinations.
nothing here is clamped. A level CV above the chosen voltage range drives the channel past unity gain.
the lamp beside each channel follows that channel's level setting rather than the signal passing through it.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes one channel.
menu: Voltage Range: 10V, 5V — sets the voltage the four Level CV jacks treat as a channel's full level
